svg.title: Pre-provisioned Azure platform and control boundaries
svg.desc: Browser HTTPS uses the Application Gateway WAF_v2 public IP and trusted IP-SAN certificate; TLS terminates at the gateway. HTTP continues logically through store-front ClusterIP :80 to application pods. Inside AKS Azure CNI Overlay with Cilium, cert-manager issues the namespaced Store TLS Secret consumed by managed AGIC for Ingress reconciliation. A fixed system node pool hosts platform workloads. Managed KEDA reconciles replicas; managed NAP provisions a bounded lab node pool for eligible pending pods. Registry image pulls are conditional. Key Vault and Storage private endpoints are supporting facilities, not assumed app dependencies.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(238, 244, 248), rgb(24, 29, 32)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(217, 226, 232), rgb(38, 46, 51));

g.text: Azure workshop platform / configured baseline, not observed health

g.text: Solid blue: configured requests. Dashed green: control / support, not measured traffic.
Supporting facilities: do not infer Store use.
Verify manifests and the private handover.
